content.Зачем hardware-стартапу блокчейн: BERS и: Why a hardware startup needs blockchain: BERS and a global testing network
content.Кажется, что блокчейн — это про криптова: Blockchain may seem to be all about cryptocurrency. At Beresta, it addresses a different challenge: verifying results from thousands of testers worldwide.
content.Зачем hardware-стартапу блокчейн | Beres: Why a hardware startup needs blockchain | Beresta Blog
content.Как блокчейн помогает Бересте собирать д: How blockchain helps Beresta collect trustworthy testing data worldwide, and why BERS is not about speculation.
content.Кажется, что блокчейн — это про криптова: Blockchain may seem to be about cryptocurrency and speculation. At Beresta, it addresses an engineering challenge: collecting trustworthy testing data from thousands of people worldwide without relying on a central server everyone must trust.
content.У Бересты есть проблема, о которой мы го: We openly acknowledge a problem: training our AI model and finding effective output algorithms is slow. There is little data, few testers, and testing currently takes place in a laboratory, literally in a single room.
content.Чтобы найти алгоритм, который работает д: Finding an algorithm that works for different people, data and conditions takes hundreds or thousands of testing sessions. We also need confidence in the data.
content.Представь: тестер Иван в Москве проводит: Imagine Ivan in Moscow reports 87% recognition accuracy for pattern A. Maria in Berlin reports 45% for the same pattern. Why? Different methods, different conditions, or a mistake in the form?
content.В централизованной системе ты просто над: In a centralized system, you rely on participants being honest. Blockchain records every transaction, or test result, immutably, with a timestamp and participant ID. Records cannot be retrospectively edited or forged.
content.Блокчейн для Бересты — это не финансовый: For Beresta, blockchain is a trust protocol for distributed testing rather than a financial instrument.
content.Тестер регистрируется в системе через пр: The tester registers through the app. The account is recorded on the blockchain.
content.Тестер надевает браслет, следует протоко: The tester wears the bracelet and follows a standard testing protocol, recording responses to a set of patterns.
content.Результаты (паттерн, точность распознава: The pattern, recognition accuracy, response time and session settings are recorded as an immutable blockchain transaction.
content.За каждую валидную сессию тестер автомат: Testers automatically receive BERS tokens for each valid session, without waiting for manual approval.
content.Проверенные данные из блокчейна использу: Verified blockchain data is used to train the AI model. More data helps improve the algorithm.
content.Что такое токен BERS — и чем он не являе: What the BERS token is, and what it is not
content.BERS — utility-токен. Это означает, что: BERS is a utility token with specific uses within the ecosystem:
content.в тестовой сети — небольшой «газ» за зап: in the testing network: a small gas fee to record data on the blockchain.
content.за приоритеты в разработке через DAO-мех: on development priorities through a DAO mechanism.
content.Чем BERS не является: инвестиционным инс: BERS is not presented as an investment instrument, a promise of returns or a speculative asset. Our goal is to create a working platform rather than another token.
content.Зачем это важно для проекта в целом: Why this matters for the project
content.Блокчейн-сеть позволяет нам масштабирова: A blockchain network lets us scale without relying on a central operator. Testers in Tokyo and São Paulo contribute data with the same verification process, changing the pace of model training.
content.Кроме того, это делает проект международ: It also makes the project international by design. Anyone with a bracelet and smartphone can participate. We want to build a global platform rather than a product for a single market.
content.Если хочешь стать одним из первых тестер: To become an early tester and network participant, apply on the participation page. Early testers receive launch priority and additional BERS rewards.
content.Как мы дошли до Бересты 3.2 | Beresta Bl: How we reached Beresta 3.2 | Beresta Blog
content.История разработки Бересты: от первого п: The story of Beresta: from an Arduino prototype to 128 vibration motors. Five years, three generations and one lesson.
content.Первый прототип обжигал кожу. Второй раз: The first prototype burned skin. The second fell apart. The third worked, but weighed almost a kilogram. Here is what happened during five years of developing a new generation of tactile bracelets.
content.Когда я начинал в 2020 году, у меня было: When I started in 2020, I had a cybernetics degree, David Eagleman's TED talk and an Arduino ordered online. And a vague belief that a tactile interface using neuroplasticity could work.
content.Сейчас у меня есть браслет с 128 вибромо: Now I have a bracelet with 128 vibration motors that communicates information through the skin. It is heavy, noisy and not particularly attractive. But it works, and that makes a big difference.
content.Береста 1.0: когда ток — плохая идея: Beresta 1.0: when current is the wrong approach
content.Первый прототип был максимально прямолин: The first prototype was straightforward: Arduino, an interface board, a display and a matrix of 64 copper electrodes. The idea was to deliver signals directly to the skin through a weak electrical current.
content.В теории это работало. На практике — нет: It worked in theory, but not in practice. After several sessions, it became clear that current damaged the skin and conductivity changed unpredictably. After an hour, the sensation was burning rather than a recognizable pattern.
content.Вывод был простым и жестким: электростим: The conclusion was clear: direct-current skin stimulation was unsuitable for prolonged wear. We needed another way to generate tactile signals.
content.Мы начали смотреть на вибромоторы. Техно: We turned to vibration motors. The technology is familiar from smartphones, but arranging it into a matrix of hundreds of points is a different challenge.
content.Береста 2.0: вибрации работают, конструк: Beresta 2.0: vibrations work, the structure does not
content.Вторая версия отличалась от первой одним: The second version replaced electrodes with vibration motors. We rewrote the firmware for the new approach, and test results became positive.
content.Мы увидели то, что искали: при регулярны: We saw what we were looking for: pattern recognition improved with regular sessions. The brain adapted. Neuroplasticity was working in our hands, beyond the theory.
content.Но сама конструкция была крайне ненадежн: But the construction was unreliable. It fit poorly, motors came loose and the basic control interface was awkward. Acceptable in a laboratory, but unsuitable for external testers.
content.Третья версия — это уже настоящий инстру: The third version is a real tool: 128 vibration motors on a silicone base, eight interface boards and a programmable microcontroller. A small display mirrors the tactile signal visually to help with learning.
content.Веб-интерфейс управления через Web Bluet: The web interface uses Web Bluetooth API to control the signal queue, durations, delays and arm selection. It connects without installing an app.
content.итерировать нужно быстро, а тестировать: iterate quickly and test on yourself immediately
content.. Каждая версия Бересты тестировалась на: . I was the first tester of every Beresta version. That was painful, literally for Beresta 1.0, but helped me quickly identify what did not work.
content.Сейчас мы в точке, где устройство работа: The device now works technically, but is not ready for everyday use. It weighs 704 grams and reaches 76 dB when touching a surface. Acceptable in a lab, but unsuitable for a café or office.
content.Береста 4.0 должна стать тем самым устро: Beresta 4.0 aims to become a device you can wear every day: smaller, quieter and more comfortable. That is what we are working on.
content.Если ты хочешь стать частью этого — посм: To get involved, visit the participation page. We need testers, developers and people who believe new senses are possible.

content.Сенсорное замещение: почему мозг учится: Sensory substitution: how the brain learns new senses | Beresta Blog
content.Объясняем нейропластичность и сенсорное: Neuroplasticity and sensory substitution explained, from Bach-y-Rita to Neosensory. The science behind Beresta in plain language.
content.В 1969 году ученый Пол Бах-и-Рита доказа: In 1969, Paul Bach-y-Rita demonstrated that blind people could see through their backs. Today, Neosensory sells bracelets for people with hearing loss. We are building Beresta to offer a new sense to everyone else.
content.Когда люди слышат про «новое чувство» —: People are often skeptical about a new sense. It sounds like science fiction. But more than half a century of research supports the ideas behind Beresta.
content.Что такое нейропластичность — и почему э: What neuroplasticity is and why it matters
content.До 1960-х считалось, что мозг взрослого: Until the 1960s, the adult brain was thought to have a fixed structure. Neurons responsible for vision would always handle vision, and hand neurons would always handle the hand. Switching was considered impossible.
content.Пол Бах-и-Рита это опроверг. Он показал: Paul Bach-y-Rita challenged that view. A camera captured images and a processor turned them into vibrations delivered to a blind person's back through a matrix. After training, people began interpreting the vibrations as visual information.
content.Мозг не просто обрабатывает сигналы от к: The brain processes information, rather than merely signals from specific receptors. When information arrives through a new route, the brain adapts.
content.Это и называется нейропластичностью: спо: Neuroplasticity is the brain's ability to reorganize its connections in response to experience. This happens beyond childhood, although learning can take longer in adults.
content.Сенсорное замещение: от лаборатории к ры: Sensory substitution: from laboratory to market
content.После Бах-и-Риты исследований накопилось: Research expanded after Bach-y-Rita. A prominent modern example is David Eagleman and Neosensory. Eagleman started with a vest that helped people with hearing loss feel sound through vibration, then developed a bracelet.
content.Параллельно существует технология BrainP: BrainPort uses a camera and an electrode array on the tongue. The brain learns to interpret electrical signals as visual information. The FDA approved the device for blind users in 2015.
content.Чем Береста отличается от существующих у: How Beresta differs from existing devices
content.Существующие устройства сенсорного замещ: Existing sensory substitution devices address specific tasks for people with hearing or visual impairments. That is valuable, but limits the market.
content.что если тактильный канал — это просто е: what if the tactile channel were simply another data input?
content.Не для компенсации потери, а для расшире: A way to expand abilities: navigation, notifications, sensor readings and monitoring can all be communicated through vibration on the skin.
content.AI решает ключевую проблему: раньше обуч: AI addresses a key challenge: learning used to take months because everyone received the same patterns. Our AI approach adapts output to the individual to accelerate learning.
content.За пять лет тестирования на Бересте 2.0: During five years of testing Beresta 2.0 and 3.2, we observed the pattern described in research: recognition improves with regular sessions. Learning is gradual rather than immediate.
content.Следующий шаг — собрать данные в масштаб: The next step is collecting data at scale. We need testers: more people sharing session results helps the AI model find suitable algorithms for different types of data.
This is where we need your help.
